sentences.text:
Rishu Masi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 December,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:63547
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Sandeep N. Bhatt
 On The 5 th Of December, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 52447 of 2025
 Rishu Masi
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Manish Datt - Senior Advocate with Shri Manish K
 Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Kamal Singh Baghel - Government Advocate for the
 respondent/State.

Shri Jitendra Kumar Awasthi - Advocate for the object
 Order

This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Crime No.0113/2024 registered at Omti,
District - Jabalpur for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406, 409, 120-B and 34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 06.11.2025.
2.

The case of prosecution in short, is that on 14.03.2024 complainant made a written complaint before the police alleging that he had purchased a car and accused persons fraudulently took the car of the complainant, later on he came to know that the accused persons are habitual in such type of activity.
The accused persons did not returned his car.
After investigation, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63547 2 MCRC-52447-2025 offence under aforesaid sections have been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He further submits that that other co-accused persons have already been granted bail.
It is contended that there was no agreement has been executed in the name of present applicant.
The persons in whose favour the agreement is executed are also released on bail.

The statements recorded by police of the various persons also having similar role like the present applicant and they are considered and enlarged on bail by this Court as well as by the Hon'ble Apex Court.

It is further submitted that accept the alleged recovery of the vehicle for which he has made an accused and a compliant was filed before the authority, that vehicle was lying in the campus of the police station Rishu Masi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50315400/
1 and the recovery is shown from him.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the applicant is studying law and is also suffering from heart ailment.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

4. Learned counsel for the objector has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and has submitted that various persons were cheated by the present applicant with the help of other co-accused persons and present applicant is a master mind and recovery is made from him.
He has further submitted that the charge-sheet is not filed yet as applicant has evaded arrest for longer period and thereafter recently in the month of November, 2025 he was arrested.

5. Learned counsel for the State has also opposed the prayer and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63547 3 MCRC-52447-2025 supported the submissions made by the counsel for the objector and has submitted that there is a gang of the persons who are indulging in such activity as well as in the FIR and as such, as per the prosecution, the present applicant is a master mind and also the period of custody is vey less.
In the other cases, the custody of the co-accused persons are of the longer period and in the present case the applicant is arrested recently and, therefore, his case may not be considered.

6. Considering the submissions made at the bar and considering the aspect of parity as almost cases of all the co-accused persons more particularly Pankaj Kharti, Naveen Khatri and Arun Masi, father of present applicant are already considered by this Court as well as the Hon'ble Apex Court for bail,
considering
additional ground that the applicant is a law student and having the medical history like heart ailment and also the fact that now applicant is arrested and charge-sheet will also be filed
, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
He is further directed to mark his presence on every first and third Monday of every NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63547 4 MCRC-52447-2025 month till the trial is concluded.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
